perks.name: Rimestealer
perks.desc: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.desc: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.desc: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.desc:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.desc: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

perks.name: Detonator Beam
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an explosion around the target.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Headstone
perks.desc: Precision final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal at the victim's location.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.desc: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Nail, Meet Hammer
perks.desc: This weapon is more effective against combatant shields. Destroying a shield with this weapon grants bonus Special ammo progress if it uses Primary or Heavy ammo, or Heavy ammo progress if it uses Special ammo.

perks.name: Omolon Fluid Dynamics
perks.desc: This weapon has increased reload speed and stability for the top half of the magazine.

notes: Adamsdown_Boy written as at v9.5.6.2 (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-SustainedDamage PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for a backup special that provides sustained boss damage, when you're out of heavy ammo, in activities rated Normal, Hard and Very Hard difficulty. Action Item is an adaptive trace rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being useful for shooting objectives and keeping special, with a decent add clear score as well. The frame intrinsic offers no bonuses beyond "being well-rounded and reliable" as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. By comparison with its peers, the stats are decent - you can see at https://d2foundry.gg/w/527989828 how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. Stability is a bit low, so to help keep hitting crits, use the barrel perk to help out or, if you're able to control the beam, spec into Handling. Use the battery perk to boost the battery capacity or reload. For sustained fire against a boss, in the first trait perk column, the obvious choice is Rewind Rounds which refills 60% of hits landed (70% when enhanced) from reserves when the magazine empties, but there's also the double damage perk possibility of High Impact Reserves which boosts damage from ×1.121 to ×1.256 as the battery drops below 50% (55% enhanced) with Target Lock in the second column, that stacks up to 5 times on repeated hits within 0.2s of each other for up to ×1.4 damage at 110.33% of base magazine capacity. There's the choice of two origin traits - Nail, Meet Hammer grants ×1.08 damage against shields, and an additional 8% Heavy Ammo progress when initially breaking the shield. Alternatively, Omolon Fluid Dynamics boosts Stability by up to +20 and Reload Speed by up to +30 in the top half of the battery, decreasing linearly until it's at 50%. Recommended MW: Stability or Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
